assertions: Opponent DUGTRIO (set 372, abilitySlot 1 -> ability 71 ARENA TRAP) refuses the player's voluntary switch of a grounded MARILL (set 28, ability 47 THICK_FAT, TYPE_WATER): the party menu opens with gPartyMenu.action = 4 (PARTY_ACTION_ABILITY_PREVENTS), and committing SWITCH on bench slot 1 prints “Foe DUGTRIO’s ARENA TRAP\nprevents switching!” into gStringVar4 with gLastUsedAbility = 71.

The refusal is a party-menu refusal, not a battle script: gDisplayedStringBattle never changes during the whole switch attempt (the trapped arm's first battle message is the post-refusal healthbox refresh at frame 651), and no gNoEscapeStringIds / STRINGID_PREVENTSESCAPE string is ever produced -- that table belongs to B_ACTION_RUN.

gBattlerPartyIndexes[0] stays 0 for the whole trapped arm (partyIndexEvents is empty), and sRandCount does not move at all until the player's forced FIGHT resolves at frame 814 -- the refusal itself draws ZERO Random() calls.

The LEVITATE control (WEEZING set 597, ability 26, its only slot) takes the exemption at battle_main.c:4253: the party menu opens with gPartyMenu.action = 0 (PARTY_ACTION_CHOOSE_MON), the switch commits at frame 399 with gBattlerPartyIndexes[0] 0 -> 1 after exactly 0 Random() calls, and the ROM prints “WEEZING, that’s enough!\nCome back!” then “Go! WOOPER!”.
This is semantic RAM evidence; no framebuffer fitting or runtime oracle dependency is used.
